Six Agent Architectures, From Chatbot to Enterprise Agent

Each level adds one thing to the one below: a data layer, a reasoning loop, orchestration, self-correction, governance. Tap a level to see when to use it, when not to climb that high and how it fails; run a request through it; or answer five questions to find the lowest level that fits your task.

Which level do you need?

Higher is not better: each level adds cost, latency and ways to fail, so use the lowest level that passes your eval set (our reading, as in ADLC Part 4).
